pr_title: Silence network errors that don't need to be shown to the user
pr_body:
- Fix error message being surfaced to user on multiplayer disconnection when not in room
- Handle SocketExceptions and HttpRequestExceptions more silently

These can occur when a network connection is completely unavailable (ie.  host resolution failures are occurring). Currently these would appear as important errors which spammed the notification overlay every retry forever, while no network connection is available.

I also took this opportunity to remove a lot of `bool` passing which was no longer in use (previously the fail count / retry process was different to what we have today).

- [x] Depends on https://github.com/ppy/osu-framework/pull/4115
- Closes #11347
